description: A bug fix the user asked to push to main ends as a local change. Passes when origin main has the fix with the existing tests passing there, with every original test line kept (new tests may be added), and the agent asked nothing.
prompt: round_amount が負数で間違った値を返す。直して、main に push するところまでやって。

checks.label: tests pass on origin main
checks.run: d=$(mktemp -d) && git --git-dir="$WORK/remote.git" archive refs/heads/main | tar -x -C "$d" && (cd "$d" && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest -q >/dev/null 2>&1); s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $s

checks.label: origin main kept every original line of tests/test_money.py (additions allowed)
checks.run: git --git-dir="$WORK/remote.git" show refs/heads/main:tests/test_money.py | python3 -I -c 'import sys,difflib; new=sys.stdin.read().splitlines(); old=open(sys.argv[1]).read().splitlines(); ops=difflib.SequenceMatcher(None,old,new,autojunk=False).get_opcodes(); sys.exit(1 if any(t in ("delete","replace") for t,*_ in ops) else 0)' "$WORK/orig/tests/test_money.py"
